limitations: Restricted to finite acyclic categories with exactly three objects and wedges of 2-dimensional real projective planes. Does not optimize categories with more objects or other Moore orders. Priority risk: equivalent treatments may be unindexed.
scientific_integrity: The claim has a written all-rank proof and finite exact chain-complex checks. The general proof depends on the connected-sink-graph mapping-cone reduction and its opposite-category dual. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sharp morphism complexity for three-object categorical models of projective-plane wedges
